pages.notImplemented: This page is still being built and will arrive in a later version.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: The address may be mistyped, or the page has been removed.

login.title: Sign in
login.locked: Too many failed attempts. Try again in {{seconds}} seconds.

errors.unauthorized: You are not signed in, or your session has expired.
errors.csrf_invalid: Your session token is out of date. Reload the page.
errors.network_error: Can't reach the server. Make sure notesteme serve is running, then retry.
errors.unrecognized_url: This URL isn't recognized. YouTube, Bilibili, podcast RSS and local files are supported.
errors.unsupported_scheme: Only http and https URLs are supported.
errors.blocked_address: This URL points to a private or local address, so it won't be fetched for security reasons.
errors.too_many_redirects: This URL redirects too many times.
errors.response_too_large: The content at this URL is too large to check.
errors.channel_not_ingestable: This is a channel. To follow new content, create a subscription.
errors.in_trash: This item is in the trash. Restore it to use it again.
errors.upstream_failed: The platform didn't respond (for example, yt-dlp failed). Try again later, and update yt-dlp if it keeps failing.
errors.upload_too_large: The file is larger than the upload limit.
errors.unsupported_media: This file has no audio or video that can be read.
errors.too_many_uploads: Another upload is in progress. Try again shortly.
errors.rate_limited: Too many requests. Try again shortly.

library.attentionNoMessage: {{stage}}: {{reason}}. Open the item to see its log.
library.empty: No media yet. Paste a YouTube, Bilibili or podcast URL, or pick a video file.
library.staleList: The connection dropped, so this list may be out of date. Reload

filters.searchHint: Press / to focus, Esc to clear
filters.channelHint: Channel ID, or click a channel in the list
filters.stageStatusHint: Within a step, any checked status matches; across steps, all must match.

add.title: Add
add.description: Paste a URL or pick a local file. Notesteme gets the subtitles and processes them with your preset.
add.urlHint: A YouTube video or playlist, a Bilibili video, or a podcast RSS feed
add.needInput: Paste a URL or pick a file.
add.invalidUrl: Enter a full URL that starts with http or https.
add.playlistWhole: Every video in the playlist will be added. Videos already in your library are not added again.
add.channelHint: This is a channel. To follow new content, create a subscription (coming in a later version).
add.requiresCookie: This video needs a signed-in account. Upload a cookie first.
add.partsInvalid: Part numbers look wrong. For example: 1, 3, 5-7.
add.profilesUnavailable: Couldn't load presets. The default preset will be used.
add.startedWithExisting_other: Started processing {{count}} items; {{existing}} already in your library
add.startedWithExisting_one: Started processing {{count}} item; {{existing}} already in your library
add.alreadyInLibrary_other: Already in your library ({{count}} items), so nothing was added.
